omission.chore: Building and checking accounting modules for transaction accuracy.
omission.evidenceQuote: Campfire raised $65m and built an entire accounting module from scratch, they only managed to achieve ~95% accuracy rate. It might feel like 95% is very close to 100%, but that is not how it works.
omission.reason: The post describes a specific accounting-module build and its accuracy problem. That concrete workflow merits assessment as a bounded accounting-software task rather than categorical exclusion for lacking an explicit service request.
